description: List campaign groups — folders that group related campaigns — with per-group campaign count and `last_run_at`. Filter by archived flag, name substring, or creation / last-run date range; a group's last run is the newest run across its campaigns. Not paginated; the org-scoped list is typically small (a few dozen groups max).

archived.description: If true, list ONLY archived groups. Default: only active groups.

created_from.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive lower bound on the creation day.

created_to.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive upper bound on the creation day.

last_run_from.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive lower bound on the most recent run. Setting either last-run bound excludes anything that has never run.

last_run_to.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive upper bound on the most recent run.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. 'Europe/Berlin') the date bounds are read in. Defaults to UTC.

name: list_campaign_groups
title: List Campaign Groups
